plugins.name: shorts-composition
plugins.description: Vertical 9:16 composition check for short-form content (Shorts, Reels, TikTok). Separates real-camera framing from AI-generated framing, because the subject-placement rule is opposite in each case: a phone's wide lens forces the face to the center, while a generated image has no lens and should use the thirds line.
